def: a string (as twisted ), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength)

occurrences.text: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
